summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an opaque bundled payload on install
details: The package advertises itself as a trivial vue-demi shim but ships a preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`), unzips it into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing a large shuffled numeric/string opcode array and a custom base64-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`), with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0xNNNN`). The obfuscated payload has no relationship to the package's stated Vue-demi shim purpose and is executed exclusively through the freshly fetched Bun runtime, keeping the behavior invisible to Node-based inspection. Fetching an alternate language runtime at preinstall solely to execute an opaque sibling bundle is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
